name: p_sshi_full_bridge_pos
rationale: Similar to the half-bridge pos, this uses a full-bridge rectifier but limits the flipping to one peak per cycle (edges=pos). This combines the efficiency of the full-bridge for low-excitation cases (S4) with a power reduction mechanism to prevent overvoltage on S1-S3. A larger C1 is used to stabilize the output and meet ripple requirements.
